# Model Overview (for Diagnosis)
BERT4Rec combines scaled item embeddings with absolute position embeddings, dropout, a bidirectional Transformer encoder with padding-key masking, and final normalization. Serving left-pads history, retains at most `maxlen−1` items, and appends reserved MASK. The final MASK representation produces candidate logits. Residual patching specifically requires two pre-norm encoder layers.

# Diagnosis Inputs & Hooks
`DiagnosisProbe(view, device)` accesses the trained network through `view.model`, plus `item_emb`, `log2feats`, `predict_score`, training histories, metadata, and category identity. The loader supplies `(None, sequence, positive, negative)` with matching B×L tensors. Diagnosis runs in evaluation mode without gradients and restores model mode and random states afterward.

# Probes & Metrics
- **Embedding alignment:** Samples up to 2,048 real-item embeddings, excluding PAD/MASK, and maps mean off-diagonal cosine to [0,1]. High values indicate alignment; 0.5 means approximately zero mean cosine, without establishing representation quality.
- **Masked-target separation:** Checks reserved tokens and all-MASK supervision across at most ten batches. Reports positive-minus-negative mean, 10th percentile, negative-win rate, and margins below 0.5. Larger margins and fewer negative wins indicate stronger in-sample separation.
- **Serving parity:** Reloads the current category checkpoint, verifies exact state identity, and compares explicit, ModelView, internal, exported, and batched scoring. Passing requires finite matching scores, identical rankings, and complete length/batching coverage.

# Perturbation & Tests
After sampler and parity checks pass, up to 64 seeded training users provide one eligible prefix each, evaluated against its target and 99 unique unseen negatives. Tests delete equally many recent or older items into PAD holes or swap the last two items, preserving positions and candidates. Outputs include score/rank/reciprocal-rank/hit deltas, ranking overlap, and paired-user bootstrap intervals.

A nominal 30-second residual pilot replaces the latest history item and patches input or intermediate residuals. Exploration locks sites/signs; disjoint confirmation users support sign tests. Identity, structural-zero, MASK-restoration, unrelated-donor, and norm-matched random controls assess implementation and intervention specificity.

# MODEL_DIAGNOSIS Schema & Limitations
Returns `{"metrics": ..., "metric_definitions": ...}` with status, availability, counts, parity, sensitivity, patch records/summaries, uncertainty, and elapsed time. `diagnosis_interpreter_prompt` requests evidence-linked JSON interpretation.

These are training-prefix diagnostics, not host validation results. Single-category output cannot establish four-category macro effects or global Holm discoveries. Missing values mean unavailable. Optimization trajectories, semantic donor compatibility, hidden traits, and unavailable review/item attributes remain unassessed; sensitivity does not establish recommendation quality or successful repairs.
